method: Visual review of 24 native-size seam segments, all9 900px junctions, 4 east and4 south edge segments, north/west core-only neighbor composites. No visual judgement inferred from metrics.

findings.description: An extra narrow column attached to the right side of the existing wide front-wall post creates a doubled cap and unjustified height step. Remove only extra narrow extension, preserve original wide post and reconnect normal wall cap to its right.

Short horizontal grout begins abruptly at west core boundary around y2404 and ends at new vertical line x~85; old neighbor has no matching groove. Continue the same broad slab through boundary or resolve joint on child side, never modify west core.
Hard material brightness/texture line across north boundary most apparent on red/gold cylinder and grey paving; geometry follows anchors.
Pink lotus petal shading changes at north core cut despite continuous silhouette.
Fine stone texture and blue inset material change visibly at west boundary; repair with W01 where possible, no RGB correction.

sourcePolicy: All16 active native PNG sources retained, actualModel/actualQuality null; one rejected blur variant preserved; only core4096 external authority.
